findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: If the URL is dynamically constructed from user input or configuration, it could lead to OS command injection.
findings.assumptions: The URL is not hardcoded and is influenced by user input or configuration.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: If email_data->size is manipulated to be larger than the actual data, memcpy could overflow the buffer.
findings.assumptions: EmailData struct is properly managed and size is always accurate.

findings.title: Weak Cryptography
findings.sink: Sending data over HTTP without encryption.
findings.trigger: If email_data_str contains sensitive information, it will be sent over an unencrypted connection.
findings.assumptions: Email content does not contain sensitive information.

findings.title: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
findings.sink: Sending data to a web server that may not sanitize the input.
findings.trigger: If the server does not properly sanitize the input, it could lead to XSS.
findings.assumptions: The server properly sanitizes all inputs.
